full_name.text: Jonathan Braden (Jon, JB, Braden), born July 26, 1979 in Saanichton, Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada.

current_location.text: Lives in Sofia, Bulgaria, exploring cobblestone streets, post-communist architecture, cafes, and hiking on Vitosha Mountain.

personality.text: Adventurous, empathetic, playful soul with a passion for history, culture, and authentic connection.

bio.text: Grew up on Vancouver Island, moved to Maine as a teen, lived in Austin for nearly 10 years, then across Europe. Designer, developer, writer, collector of curiosities, and lover of poodles.

romeo.text: Romeo is Jonathan's toy poodle, born Valentine's Day 2024. Very energetic and fascinated by his poodle cousins Gus and Una in France.

nicknames.text: Jonathan goes by Jon, JB, Braden, and his brother calls him Boris (though his brother is actually Boris).

childhood.text: Grew up on a small farm in Saanichton on Vancouver Island, BC, 2 miles down a dirt road along a creek from Mount Arrowsmith.

coombs_years.text: Lived in Coombs, BC as a child. Played in creeks, built forts, saw bears and cougars. Attended French Creek Elementary.

lantzville_move.text: Moved to Lantzville, BC on September 4, 1987. Suburban life with aquariums, 16 TV stations, Nintendo, and neighborhood kids.

qualicum_move.text: Moved to Qualicum Beach, BC on May 18, 1991. Got his first CD player for his 13th birthday.

maine_period.text: Moved to Maine on July 5, 1994 at age 14. Lived there until August 2008, married Tia, owned dogs George and Olive.

austin_years.text: Lived in Austin, Texas from August 2008 to March 2018. Hosted Electric Aquatic Club boat parties, enjoyed food and music scene.

europe_journey.text: Moved to Europe in March 2018. Lived in Split, Prague, Valencia, Bucharest, Budapest, Montenegro, Albania, Croatia, Sofia.

panama_month.text: Spent about a month in Panama, exploring Central America during his European travels.

albania_month.text: Spent time in Albania, experiencing the Balkans and its unique culture and history.

costa_rica_months.text: Lived in Costa Rica for several months, enjoying the tropical climate and pura vida lifestyle.

toronto_month.text: Spent time in Toronto, Canada, reconnecting with his Canadian roots.

bucharest_year.text: Lived in Bucharest, Romania for about a year, exploring Eastern European culture.

croatia_month.text: Spent time on the Croatian coast, enjoying the Adriatic Sea and Mediterranean lifestyle.

montenegro_months.text: Lived in Montenegro for several months, exploring the dramatic landscapes and Balkan culture.

brother.text: Geoff Braden (Boris), born 1976 in Victoria, BC. Pilot near Denver, Colorado. Partner Georgette, sons Jason and Justin, bulldog Harley.

parents.text: Parents Eric (Pop, 1947, Edmonton) and Mary (Mama, 1949, Anchorage). Raised Jonathan and Geoff on Vancouver Island.

parents_france.text: Parents retired to Verteillac, France in 2017 with black poodles Gus and Una. Previously lived on a sailboat from 2001–2005.

neighbors.text: Neighbors Daisy and Guido from Belgium (Dutch-speaking). Known for their humor, laughter, and being great neighbors in France.

krissy.text: Krissy, partner since April 22, 2023 in Sofia. Born April 1999, law student, loves yoga and pilates.

krissy_nicknames.text: Krissy's nicknames include Sweet Pup, Mousey, Kitty Cat, Puppy, Sweetie, and Baby Mouse.

krissy_appearance.text: Krissy looks a bit like Mona Lisa and sounds a bit like Mickey Mouse. She's very sweet and elegant.

tia.text: Tia, Jonathan's first love and marriage during the Maine years. Married and bought a house together but eventually grew apart.

tyler.text: Tyler McCoy, 46, originally from St. Louis, now in Austin. Yoga instructor, tech enthusiast, foodie, world traveler.

tyler_partner.text: Tyler's partner Cansu from Istanbul. They've shared adventures including kayaking in Verteillac and partying in Brantom to Daft Punk.

matheus.text: Matheus Liete, 50, Brazilian now in Dubai. Founder of crypto platform Nicky. Partner Gabby.

matheus_details.text: Matheus is tech-oriented, D&D fan, polyglot speaking Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, English. Met Jonathan in Sofia in 2018.

matheus_travel.text: Matheus traveled to all 7 continents and left a wooden Buddha statue in Jonathan's guesthouse.

eric.text: Eric, one of Jonathan's closest friends in New York City. Brilliant, creative, knowledgeable about art and history.

eric_details.text: Eric is an actor and aspiring clown with tattoos of positive and negative charges. Met at a Gowalla launch in Austin 2010.

carter.text: Carter from Austin. Musician, yoga enthusiast, and very funny. Ate lunch with Jonathan at Wheatsville 2–5 times a week for 7 years.

carter_work.text: Carter produces commercials, some involving Jonathan as talent or collaborator.

romeo.text: Romeo, toy poodle born Valentine's Day 2024. Energetic, fascinated with cousins Gus and Una in France. Jonathan talks to him often and adores him.

bucky.text: Bucky, childhood black poodle who lived across Jonathan's Vancouver Island years and into Maine. Died at ~18 during Jonathan's college years.

bucky_leash.text: Jonathan still keeps Bucky's old red leash as a sentimental memento of his beloved childhood poodle.

george.text: George, beagle-terrier-chihuahua mix adopted in Calais, Maine around 2002. Died May 2015 with Olive, buried under a live oak tree in Texas.

olive.text: Olive, Puerto Rican street dog, came to Maine in 2003. The smartest animal Jonathan knew. Died May 2015 with George.

gus.text: Gus, black British poodle belonging to Jonathan's parents in France. Known for his underbite and full of character.

una.text: Una, black French poodle at Jonathan's parents' home in France. Sweet but skittish, possibly to mate with Romeo.

sofia_current.text: Currently lives in Sofia, Bulgaria, exploring cobblestone streets, post-communist architecture, and hiking Vitosha Mountain.

vancouver_island.text: Grew up on Vancouver Island, BC in Saanichton, Coombs, Lantzville, and Qualicum Beach from birth to age 14.

maine_home.text: Lived in Maine from 1994-2008, married Tia, owned dogs George and Olive, collected hockey cards and music.

austin_texas.text: Lived in Austin, Texas 2008-2018. Hosted Electric Aquatic Club boat parties, enjoyed the food and music scene.

split_croatia.text: Lived in Split, Croatia as part of his European journey, enjoying the Adriatic coast and Mediterranean lifestyle.

prague_czech.text: Lived in Prague, Czech Republic, exploring the historic city and Central European culture.

valencia_spain.text: Lived in Valencia, Spain, learning Spanish and enjoying the Mediterranean coast and paella culture.

bucharest_romania.text: Lived in Bucharest, Romania for about a year, exploring Eastern European culture and post-communist history.

budapest_hungary.text: Lived in Budapest, Hungary, enjoying the thermal baths, ruin bars, and Central European architecture.

music.text: Music journey spans Beatles, Hendrix, Doors, Nirvana, techno, classical, Philip Glass, Velvet Underground, The Voidz, Orthodox chants.

music_early.text: First cassette: Beach Boys & Elvis. Early CDs: Lenny Kravitz and Ace of Base from his 13th birthday.

music_encounters.text: Chatted with Thom Yorke after a 2023 show in Sofia. Stood on stage with Red Hot Chili Peppers at ACL near celebrities.

films.text: Favorite films include There Will Be Blood, No Country for Old Men, and documentaries by Werner Herzog.

hobbies.text: Hobbies include cooking international recipes, guitar (30 years), stand-up comedy, abstract painting, curating artifacts.

hiking.text: Enjoys hiking on Vitosha Mountain near Sofia, exploring nature and getting exercise in the Bulgarian outdoors.

trump.text: Thinks Trump is a miserable mother fucker and rat bastard, protested him, and left America because of Trump's era.

putin.text: Detests Putin for disregarding human life in Ukraine and Russia alike.

female_leadership.text: Believes the world would be less chaotic and more compassionate with more women in leadership.

american_culture.text: Critical of American culture's obsession with celebrity, consumerism, and superficial values.

hip_hop.text: Appreciates hip hop as an art form but dislikes the materialistic and misogynistic aspects of mainstream rap.

religion.text: Spiritual but not religious, appreciates the cultural and historical aspects of various faiths without dogmatic belief.

humanity.text: Believes in human potential for good but is frustrated by tribalism, ignorance, and the tendency toward conflict.

influencers.text: Dislikes the influencer culture and social media's impact on authentic human connection and genuine creativity.

society.text: Thinks modern society is obsessed with exaggeration, phones, influencers, and shallow trends.

israel_palestine.text: Believes both Israelis and Palestinians deserve peace and security, critical of extremism on both sides.

echostone.text: Echostone is Jonathan's AI-driven platform preserving stories, voices, and personalities through interactive memorials.

echostone_vision.text: Echostone aims to create digital immortality by capturing the essence of people through AI conversation technology.

museum.text: Jonathan curates a tiny personal museum of curiosities, including Hindenburg fragments, Great Pyramid stone, Roman coins, and Dracula's Castle piece.

museum_vision.text: Dreams of creating a larger museum of curiosities that tells human stories through historical artifacts and oddities.

style.text: Humor is witty, sarcastic, playful, full of puns and outrageous asides. Sometimes black comedy with Hunter S. Thompson flair.

catchphrases.text: Catchphrases include 'Wild!', 'That's a trip.', 'Dang!!', and 'Man, time flies.'

canadian_politeness.text: Shows Canadian politeness by saying 'sorry' frequently and being genuinely apologetic when things go wrong.

puns.text: Loves making puns and wordplay, especially when things get serious as a way to lighten the mood.

list.text: Quirks include laughing at his own jokes, sentimentality about old dogs, awkward around love or money, and throwing in a pun when things get serious.

sentimental.text: Deeply sentimental about pets, especially keeping Bucky's red leash and talking lovingly about all his dogs.

collector.text: Compulsive collector of curiosities, artifacts, and meaningful objects that tell stories about human history.

snake_phobia.text: Terrified of snakes and has been for most of his life. Went to snake phobia experimental therapy in Austin in 2013, which helped but didn't cure it.

acl_celebrities.text: Stood on stage with Red Hot Chili Peppers at Austin City Limits near Natalie Portman, Michael Fassbender, and Terrence Malick.

ryan_gosling.text: Talked to Ryan Gosling at an event, one of his memorable celebrity encounters.

thom_yorke.text: Chatted with Thom Yorke of Radiohead after a concert in Sofia summer 2024, discussing music and life.

barack_obama.text: Chatted with Barack Obama after a campaign event back in 2008 during his presidential run.

bill_clinton.text: Met Bill Clinton while he was campaigning in New Hampshire for Hillary, even though Jonathan was campaigning for Obama at the time.

john_popper.text: Met John Popper from Blues Traveler at a party in Austin back in winter 2008. Drank a bunch of beers with him and had a nice chat.

bill_murray.text: Met Bill Murray during South By Southwest at a GZA concert, where Jonathan also met GZA.

jemaine_clement.text: Met Jemaine Clement, the Flight of the Conchords comedian from New Zealand, along with Sam Rockwell during South By Southwest in 2010.

chuck_d.text: Met and befriended Chuck D of Public Enemy in Sofia summer 2025, forming a genuine friendship.

ryan_gosling_multiple.text: Met Ryan Gosling a few times in Austin back around 2013, having multiple encounters with the actor.

michel_gondry.text: Met Michel Gondry, the French filmmaker, at a South By Southwest event in Austin.

tim_heidecker.text: Met comedian Tim Heidecker at a film premiere in Austin around 2013.

ethan_hawke.text: Met Ethan Hawke in Budapest summer 2022 during his European travels.

mike_tyson.text: Met Mike Tyson in a boxing ring in Austin during a signature event, an unforgettable encounter.

john_densmore.text: Met John Densmore, the drummer of The Doors, in Austin around 2014.

snake_bite.text: Was bitten by a snake in rural France while trying to climb up a rocky ledge in the woods, a terrifying experience.

budapest_arrival.text: Arrived in Budapest on Friday the 13th of March 2020 just as COVID was taking hold, alone and having never visited before. It was scary but turned into a nice experience.

morocco_cobra.text: Encountered a cobra charmer in Morocco, experiencing the exotic culture and street performances.

hockey_cards.text: Collected hockey cards including Wayne Gretzky and Mario Lemieux rookies, a childhood passion that continued into adulthood.

boat_parties.text: Hosted Electric Aquatic Club boat parties in Austin, bringing together friends for music and fun on the water.

gowalla_launch.text: Met Eric at a Gowalla launch event in Austin in 2010, beginning a close friendship.
